'''Geno Namit''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[captain]] in the [[Resistance navy|naval forces]] of the [[Resistance]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. During the [[Battle of Oetchi|attack]] on the [[Resistance navy|Resistance fleet]] by the First Order following the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation]] from the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref> he served under [[Vice Admiral]] [[Amilyn Holdo]] on the [[Free Virgillia-class Bunkerbuster|''Free Virgillia''-class Bunkerbuster]] ''[[Ninka]]''. When the primary [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the [[MC85 Star Cruiser]] [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] was destroyed, [[Death|killing]] almost all of [[Resistance High Command]] and injuring [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], Namit joined Holdo and several other officers loyal to her in transferring to the ''Raddus'' so that the vice [[admiral]] could take command of the fleet as the highest ranking officer still able to command. Captain Namit survived the [[Battle of Oetchi]] and made it to [[Crait]], whereupon he managed to escape alongside other members of the Resistance in the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' during the [[Battle of Crait]].<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
He wore a [[Color|brown]] [[brismoss]]-fiber [[Clothing|uniform]] tunic with dark brown pants, brown [[boot]]s, and a [[belt]] where he carried a [[Glie-44 blaster pistol]] in a [[holster]]. Namit's skin was fair in color and his [[hair]] was brown.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Geno Namit was portrayed by [[Hugh Skinner]] in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="Episode VIII" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="Episode VIII" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
